stages.name: security_preflight
stages.gate: decision must be ALLOW or satisfied ALLOW_WITH_CONDITIONS

stages.name: skeleton_write
stages.gate: writer finalizes a handoff with assignment, baseline, and final snapshot IDs

stages.name: skeleton_review
stages.gate: both reviews match the writer assignment and final snapshot; monitor is ALIGNED and security is not DENY

stages.name: module_write
stages.gate: writer finalizes one module handoff with focused test evidence

stages.name: module_review
stages.gate: both reviews match the module assignment and final snapshot; ownership passes, monitor is ALIGNED, and security is not DENY

stages.name: generalized_tuning_write
stages.gate: visible training metrics are recorded, the prompt-only proposal manifest is frozen, and local status remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_INTEGRATOR

stages.name: generalized_tuning_review
stages.gate: reviews match the frozen proposal snapshot; signed baseline and candidate metrics from independent external validation and blind holdout do not regress; explicit digest-bound approval remains external

stages.name: final_acceptance
stages.gate: monitor reports ALIGNED, security reports ALLOW, and supervisor verifies all success criteria

runLedger.attestation: external Ed25519 signature created by immutable tooling outside the workspace, verified by .codex/agent-ledger-public-key.pem, and matched to managed WORKFLOW_TRUST_ROOT_SHA256
runLedger.snapshots: complete file-hash maps with recomputed SHA-256 tree IDs
runLedger.independentEvaluation: external-validation and blind-holdout reports are each Ed25519-signed, bind baseline and candidate artifact hashes, and carry deterministic integer metrics with no hard, security, objective, or protected-category regression
runLedger.tuningApproval: a separate Ed25519-signed one-time approval binds the baseline, candidate snapshot, proposal digest, target set, scope, nonce, and unconsumed state; only the external integrator consumes it
runLedger.capabilityApprovals: exact Code, Data Table, or Execute Workflow node type plus reviewed artifact hash, integrated snapshot, and explicit user approval
runLedger.n8nMutations: exact tool-input hashes, session ID, 15-minute lifetime, approval scope, and one-time nonces bound to the reviewed integrated snapshot
